# NextGen Analytics Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

NextGen Analytics delivered strong financial performance in Q4 2024, reporting total revenue of $3,585,492, representing a robust 10.2% year-over-year growth from the previous year's $3,254,790. The company achieved net income of $826,717 with an impressive operating margin of 23.1%, demonstrating effective cost management and operational efficiency across our 1,570-person workforce. These results underscore NextGen Analytics' continued momentum in the healthcare technology sector and our ability to capitalize on the growing demand for data-driven healthcare solutions.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's revenue growth of $330,702 year-over-year reflects strong market adoption of our healthcare analytics solutions and successful execution of our growth strategy. Our operating margin of 23.1% significantly outperforms industry benchmarks, highlighting our disciplined approach to scaling operations while maintaining profitability. The healthy margin profile demonstrates our ability to generate substantial returns on invested capital while continuing to invest in research and development, talent acquisition, and market expansion initiatives that position us for sustained long-term growth.

## Business Segment Performance

NextGen Analytics' diversified product portfolio continues to drive market penetration across the healthcare ecosystem. Our Patient Analytics platform has seen increased adoption among health systems seeking to improve clinical outcomes and operational efficiency, while our Telemedicine Platform has benefited from the sustained shift toward digital healthcare delivery models. The EHR System segment has shown particular strength in the mid-market healthcare provider space, where our integrated approach to data analytics and electronic health records provides compelling value propositions. This multi-product strategy has enabled us to deepen relationships with existing clients while attracting new customers across various healthcare verticals.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead, NextGen Analytics is well-positioned to maintain our growth trajectory in 2025, supported by a robust pipeline of enterprise clients and continued innovation in our core product offerings. We anticipate revenue growth in the range of 12-15% for the upcoming fiscal year, driven by expanding market opportunities in value-based care analytics and AI-powered clinical decision support tools. Our strong balance sheet and proven operational efficiency provide the foundation for strategic investments in emerging technologies and potential market expansion, while we remain committed to delivering sustainable profitability and shareholder value in the rapidly evolving healthcare technology landscape.
